parameters.name: AlertType
parameters.description: The threat type.

parameters.name: AlertTypeMds
parameters.description: The Medusa code of the threat type.

parameters.name: AttCk
parameters.description: The ATT\&CK technique.

parameters.name: EventTransferExt
parameters.description: The extended information for event generation. This parameter is returned only when EventTransferType is set to allToSingle. The value indicates the length and unit of the alert aggregation window.

parameters.name: EventTransferSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to convert alerts into events. Valid values:

- 0: no

- 1: yes

parameters.name: EventTransferType
parameters.description:
The event generation method. Valid values:

- default: the default method

- singleToSingle: An event is generated for each alert.

- allToSingle: An event is generated for all alerts in a period.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom rule.

parameters.name: LogSource
parameters.description: The log source of the rule.

parameters.name: LogSourceMds
parameters.description: The Medusa code of the log source.

parameters.name: LogType
parameters.description: The log type of the rule.

parameters.name: LogTypeMds
parameters.description: The Medusa code of the log type.

parameters.name: QueryCycle
parameters.description: The length of the rule window.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland and China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID that is used to switch the administrator's perspective to a member's perspective.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator.

parameters.name: RuleCondition
parameters.description: The query condition of the rule. The value is a JSON string.

parameters.name: RuleDesc
parameters.description: The description of the rule.

parameters.name: RuleGroup
parameters.description: The fields that are used to group logs. The value is a JSON array.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the rule.

parameters.name: RuleThreshold
parameters.description: The threshold configuration of the rule. The value is a JSON string.

parameters.name: ThreatLevel
parameters.description:
The threat level. Valid values:

- serious: high

- suspicious: medium

- remind: low
